plan.averaging: equal arithmetic mean in float64; cast once to source dtype; all nonfloating buffers must agree
plan.calibration: unchanged v9 type-intercepts and GP/boundary slopes, ridge10/50; same decoder grid and folds; all fitting and route selection fit-only
plan.acceptance: full-dev Micro >= v14; workflow crossfit Micro strictly higher; neither held-out half lower
plan.hardware: 2x RTX4090 24GB; inference batch16 per GPU; no neural training
